items.name: eva-badge
items.title: Eva Badge
items.description: Content-sized interface labels whose frame grows around one or two text levels.
items.docs: EvaBadge derives its width and height from the rendered labels, typography, padding, gap, rule, and border. The wider text level sets the frame width, so adding a shorter secondary label only adds height. Layout treats the badge as one atomic item. When its container is narrower than its intrinsic width, the complete badge scales proportionally instead of compressing individual parts. Use className and style for the atomic layout shell; use frameClassName and frameStyle for the visible badge. Use size for coordinated defaults, or override fontSize, secondaryFontSize, paddingInline, paddingBlock, gap, borderWidth, cornerRadius, and separatorThickness. horizontalScale changes both the visible type and measured frame width.

items.name: eva-text
items.title: Eva Text
items.description: Display typography with Evangelion-inspired font roles, tracking, and horizontal scaling.
items.docs: EvaText supports standard HTML attributes, style, and refs. Without fit, horizontalScale changes the rendered shape without changing layout width. With fit, a single line reserves its scaled dimensions and shrinks to the parent content width. Use unscaled text for wrapping body copy.

items.name: eva-segment-display
items.title: Eva Segment Display
items.description: A configurable seven-segment renderer for numeric display strings.
items.docs: EvaSegmentDisplay draws a supplied string without parsing or formatting it. Supported visible characters are 0-9, colon, decimal point, and minus. Spaces and unsupported characters reserve a blank digit position. Use digitSize for CSS height and digitWidth, segmentThickness, segmentGap, and characterGap for glyph geometry. Every segment shares the same junction coordinates and 45-degree bevel angle. segmentGap controls the diagonal clearance between adjoining bevels. Width resolves to 32-100 units, thickness to 3-20 units or 30% of digit width, character gap to 0-40 units, and segment gap to the largest non-intersecting value up to 8 units. resolveEvaSegmentGeometry returns the applied values and coupled limits. ghostOpacity accepts 0-1. The SVG scales proportionally when its container is narrower than its natural width. Build timers, clocks, percentages, and readouts by composing this component with separate formatting and state logic.

items.name: eva-stripe
items.title: Eva Stripe
items.description: Configurable diagonal signal bands for frame edges, warnings, and status regions.
items.docs: EvaStripe renders a decorative repeating gradient and never controls its own placement. Give its parent the required width, height, and position. angle describes the visible band in degrees; a negative angle descends from left to right. band and gap use CSS pixels. orientation describes the edge direction and selects a seamless scroll axis. tone can inherit currentColor or use an EVA signal color. motion is a discriminated union with none and scroll states. Scrolling respects prefers-reduced-motion. The root is aria-hidden and ignores pointer input.
